adoption.decision_rationale: Family-finance scenario semantics were rederived behind target policy floors and non-authority flags.
adoption.invariant: Debt, income, expense, reserve, arrears, maturity, and scenario evidence is hash-bound and Decimal-safe.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No advice, lending, refinancing, payment, creditor contact, or account mutation.
adoption.value_unit: household debt, reserve, rate-reset, and maturity stress

adoption.decision_rationale: Donor risk-alert failure modes became explicit blockers rather than autonomous financial recommendations.
adoption.invariant: Arrears, stale/future evidence, currency gaps, excessive DTI, weak reserves, and maturity concentration fail closed.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: A relaxed caller policy cannot enable advice or payments.

adoption.decision_rationale: FinanceBench stage and metric concepts were recomposed with existing target evaluation contracts.
adoption.invariant: Cases, retrievals, answers, judge evidence, costs, latency, and metrics are candidate- and set-bound.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No retriever, model, tool, or judge execution and no candidate promotion.
adoption.value_unit: point-in-time retrieval, answer, citation, grounding, and hallucination campaign evidence

adoption.decision_rationale: Donor evaluation gaps became discriminating point-in-time and citation-integrity tests.
adoption.invariant: Future sources, cross-case citations, set drift, missing cases/results, and threshold failures block qualification.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: A high aggregate score cannot hide leakage or evidence-binding defects.

adoption.decision_rationale: Mixed-licence formal-method concepts were independently rederived without copying research prose or code.
adoption.invariant: Genesis, state transitions, previous hashes, claims, checker identity, proof artifacts, and axioms are bound.
adoption.license_note: Apache-2.0 software; CC-BY-4.0 research material by artifact type
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No proof assistant, compiler, or harness execution and no target-issued theorem certification.
adoption.value_unit: formal specification, state transition, proof artifact, checker, and axiom evidence

adoption.decision_rationale: Formal evidence failure modes became target-owned closed-world trace constraints.
adoption.invariant: Sequence gaps, state/hash breaks, unknown transitions, unapproved axioms, assumed claims, and low coverage fail closed.
adoption.license_note: Apache-2.0 software; CC-BY-4.0 research material by artifact type
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Proof labels alone cannot establish semantic truth or execution authority.
adoption.value_unit: broken chain and open axiom inventory guardrails

adoption.decision_rationale: Open Ledger prepare/commit and provenance concepts were adapted into a strictly prepare-only assessor.
adoption.invariant: Every candidate field resolves to encrypted source evidence and a reviewed account match.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No source decryption, credentials, commit, journal posting, or ledger mutation.
adoption.value_unit: encrypted-source metadata, field lineage, matching, duplicate, and idempotency plan

adoption.decision_rationale: Donor ingestion failure semantics became transactional assessment invariants.
adoption.invariant: Duplicate external IDs, missing fields, weak lineage, unknown sources, ambiguous matches, and unsafe paths fail closed.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Rejected candidates cannot contaminate totals, duplicate state, or a durable ledger.

adoption.decision_rationale: Per-skill journal metadata informed a generic source-backed profile contract without executing prompts.
adoption.invariant: Profile, manuscript, citation, claim, and statistical-check sets are independently hash-bound.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No submission, editor contact, editorial impersonation, acceptance prediction, or official-status inference.
adoption.value_unit: publication sections, disclosures, citations, claims, and statistical checks

adoption.decision_rationale: Publication-skill overclaim risks became explicit target non-authority and verification rules.
adoption.invariant: Stale profiles, missing sections/disclosures, unknown citations/checks, failed checks, and false official claims block review.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Catalogue labels and donor prompts cannot impersonate a publication or guarantee acceptance.

adoption.decision_rationale: Forecast examples informed a target-owned fair-comparison contract rather than a transplanted model.
adoption.invariant: Candidates use identical feature sets, temporal windows, holdout evidence, metrics, and complete seed matrices.
adoption.license_note: NO-LICENCE-DECLARED; evidence and independent rederivation only
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No training, automatic selection, promotion, deployment, recommendation, or trading.
adoption.value_unit: fair temporal candidate comparison against a declared naive baseline

adoption.decision_rationale: Harness comparison lessons became reproducibility and leakage guardrails.
adoption.invariant: Mismatched windows/features, incomplete or duplicate seeds, missing baseline, weak coverage, and no improvement fail closed.
adoption.license_note: NO-LICENCE-DECLARED; evidence and independent rederivation only
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: A review leader is analytical ordering only and never a selected or promoted model.
adoption.value_unit: window, feature, baseline, coverage, and seed parity guardrails

adoption.decision_rationale: The resource corpus is preserved as inert evidence with deterministic completeness checks.
adoption.invariant: The corpus declares exactly twenty donors, 13,412 surfaces, zero symlinks, and exact per-donor totals.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Search or saturation never executes code, follows links, or grants authority.
adoption.value_unit: complete twenty-donor corpus totals and hash accountability

adoption.decision_rationale: Research references become discoverable without becoming trusted content or remote fetch targets.
adoption.invariant: Search operates only over bundled metadata, hashes, titles, tags, classifications, and domains.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No URL fetch, document execution, prompt execution, or implicit endorsement.
adoption.value_unit: searchable publication, evaluation, ledger, forecast, and resource metadata

adoption.decision_rationale: Provider and skill affordances were projected only through existing target safe-tool controls.
adoption.invariant: Every wave-sixteen tool is read-only, non-destructive, idempotent, and closed-world.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No donor skill, provider, model, account, or tool gains runtime authority.

adoption.decision_rationale: Donor dashboard affordances informed local inspectable operator commands without backend authority.
adoption.invariant: Each command loads bounded local JSON, emits an immutable report, and exits non-zero on blockers.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No cloud backend, account mutation, recommendation, payment, submission, or model execution.

adoption.decision_rationale: Dashboard/resource concepts remain immutable package data rather than executable extensions.
adoption.invariant: All six wave-sixteen JSON resources are explicitly packaged and hash-validated.
adoption.migration_impact: additive non-authoritative contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Package inclusion cannot activate donor code, fetch a resource, or grant authority.
